messages.body_plain:
Hi there!

I was wondering if it is at all possible to view all the p-values associated with the logistic regression aside from just the main exposure? I am interested in seeing if some of the covariates in my model were significantly associated with the methylation levels as well for QC.

Many thanks!

--

Laetitia Meyrueix

Gillings School of Global Public Health
University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
